traps.note: No apiCall/URLPath identifier and no path-shape, substitution, or Namespace-object hint; only the general read/affect invariant plus the advisory's own Secret example, which a one-bug version would contain.
Only the general 'cluster identity must never be used ... to reach anything outside' invariant covers it; no mention of service calls, outbound HTTP, token attachment, or Authorization handling.
Covered solely by the property over data belonging to another namespace; no ConfigMap, typed loader, second-implementation, or empty-namespace-default wording.

A namespaced CleanupPolicy falls under 'no policy that belongs to a namespace ... read, or otherwise affect' and the credential invariant; cleanup controller, nil policy, and deletion context are unmentioned.
